newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot gasoline gains dampen demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot gasoline gains dampen demand.

text.p: NWE spot gasoline prices strengthened on Wednesday but the higher prices stalled trade.

Traders said tight supplies and good buying interest supported barges with one Rotterdam refiner again seen covering easily today. Open U.S. arbitrage options, despite a 2.3 million barrel build in the API's stock report, buoyed cargo prices. "The arbitrage is open, but Europe is looking pretty clean of (cargo) offers at the moment," one trader said.
But European demand for cargoes was slack with buyers around $204 cif Hamburg for Eurograde, well below the offer of $213.
